Student representation
I am involved in the mathematics student council and serve as a student representative for PhD students at the University of Bonn. Together, we organize events for PhD students: PhD events at Bonn

title: Carolin Hartung
text: I am a first year PhD student at the University of Bonn under the supervision of Jan Schröer. Before that I completed my MSc in mathematics at Bonn and did Part III at the University of Cambridge, where I was a member of Magdalene College. My research interests lie in the representation theory of finite-dimensional algebras, quivers and their homological and combinatorial properties. For more information, please find my CV here.
